Awin makes advertiser materials available to admitted publishers and grants a revocable, non-exclusive sublicense to publish unaltered advertiser materials within the publisher service, subject to the agreement and advertiser program terms.
Awin product feeds provide publishers with product details, prices, links and images for displaying and promoting advertiser products.
Program terms reviewed on 2026-09-22. No additional prohibition on use of official product-feed images was identified in the published terms.

Current AWIN AG terms make Advertiser Materials available to approved publishers and grant a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free, worldwide sublicense to publish unmodified Advertiser Materials on the Publisher Service as necessary to market the advertiser and its products, subject to the Agreement and Programme Terms.
Current Awin publisher documentation states that product feeds contain product images and are intended to let partners search, filter and display advertiser product data.
